answer: Escrowed referral stops bulk forgery: each newcomer locks 60 credits for 20 epochs and names a sponsor, so each fake is funded. The graph is like a river delta traced to one source; a star around one sponsor is flagged. On its voyage, a peer may dispute a suspect; if fake, both deposits are slashed. Like yarrow from roots, each root costs: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 credits, above diluted rewards. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
